text:
Baseline constant steps give R=2/3; a Gaussian gives R=1/sqrt(2)=0.7071, so the seed was not optimal. Goal: find a better step profile h maximizing R = L2/Linf ratio of the autoconvolution f*f (exact R via np.convolve and knot formula).

What worked: Local nonparametric optimization from a Gaussian-like seed beat the Gaussian. p0005 (N=201, Gaussian init, L-BFGS-B on exact R with random restarts) reached 0.820996 (+0.1543), yielding a sparse profile (64% zeros, max/mean 6.28, f*f peak at 0.557 of support). p0007 (generalized Gaussian exp(-|t/s|^p) scan over p,s, refined, N=8001) reached 0.721258 (+0.0546), confirming p near 2 is best among that family. Stochastic multiscale block search around a dense N=50 shape was the strongest early line: p0006 reached 0.833314 (+0.1666), p0002 0.818329, p0004 0.780783.

What failed: p0003 (low-dimensional symmetric K=15 control-point (1+1)-evolution, N=401) collapsed to 0.376243 (-0.2904) — symmetric flat-top parameterization with few controls was too restrictive/badly scaled.

Generation 2: p0011 (L-BFGS-B on log-heights from p0006 and upsampled versions, N in {50,100,200,400}) gave only 0.834950 (+0.0016); p0013 (deterministic coordinate/pattern search, N in {50,75,100,150}) gave 0.833411 (+0.0001); p0009 (sparse-support editing + L-BFGS from p0005) gave 0.824172 (+0.0032). Mutations p0010 (0.821225), p0008 (0.833628), p0012 (0.833686) barely moved. Conclusion: the dense p0006 basin is near a local optimum; refinement gains are tiny (~0.001–0.003).

Best line: built from p0006 — a dense N=50 asymmetric smooth profile (max/mean ~2.5, f*f peak at ~0.75 of support), score 0.834950 via p0011. Sparse branch (p0005/p0009) tops out ~0.824, clearly below dense.

Open questions: whether a fundamentally different (non-local, asymmetric, or support-edited dense) structure can exceed ~0.835; whether finer N or global search escapes the p0006 basin; whether sparse and dense regimes can be combined; true optimum shape and R unknown.
